title: Defended conditional Carrier-CC cost envelope under HEUR-S1

heuristics.HEUR-S1: Underestimation of log2(Pwrong) by Δ bits is paid as +Δ in log2(R·(N·Tdec+TFFT)). Accounting convention, not measured ε-restoration physics.

non_claims: Not a corrected Carrier security level
Not a measured Kyber-scale Pwrong error
The ~84-bit KN-FIND-012 quantity is a coverage/extrapolation distance (toy floor vs Table C.2), NOT a value of Δ
Score-scale: use KN-FIND-014 aligned T-gap (~421), not raw EV-011 T-gap
reading: Carrier CC shortfalls (3.5/11.9/12.3 bits) are thin. Under HEUR-S1 alone, Δ≈9.46/14.36/14.76 already meets NIST cutoffs. Whether true Δ is that large is open; KN-FIND-012/014 only show that Fig 4.1 does not empirically cover the aligned operating threshold, so large Δ cannot be ruled out by those simulations.
